title: Microsoft Defender antivirus is enabled
description: Checks the AntivirusEnabled status reported by Get-MpComputerStatus. This v1 check does not recognize third-party antivirus products.
remediation: Review endpoint protection policy with the administrator. Enable Microsoft Defender antivirus or document an approved alternative; CyberAssess makes no changes.

title: Microsoft Defender real-time protection is enabled
description: Checks the RealTimeProtectionEnabled status reported by Microsoft Defender. An unsupported or unavailable Defender query is an ERROR.
remediation: Review Microsoft Defender real-time protection and any approved exclusion or alternative protection policy with the administrator.

title: All three Windows firewall profiles are enabled
description: Requires Domain, Private and Public profiles from the effective ActiveStore, with no missing, duplicate or unknown profile states.
remediation: Review management connectivity, then have the administrator enable and verify all Domain, Private and Public Windows firewall profiles.

title: BitLocker OS-volume protection is on
description: Checks protection status for the volume identified by SystemDrive. This does not assert encryption completion or assess recovery-key storage. Unsupported editions or denied access are ERROR.
remediation: Have the administrator review BitLocker support, encryption state and recovery-key escrow before enabling or resuming OS-volume protection.

title: Remote Desktop connections are disabled
description: Checks the explicit fDenyTSConnections setting. This local baseline expects incoming Remote Desktop to be disabled.
remediation: Disable incoming Remote Desktop through approved policy unless an authorized, documented management exception requires it.

title: Remote Desktop Network Level Authentication is required
description: Checks the explicit RDP-Tcp UserAuthentication policy value, even when RDP connections are disabled, for defense in depth. An absent value remains ERROR.
remediation: Configure Network Level Authentication for Remote Desktop through approved policy and verify authorized client compatibility.

title: The built-in local Guest account is disabled
description: Identifies the local Guest account by SID RID 501, independently of its localized or renamed account name.
remediation: Have the administrator disable the built-in local Guest account after reviewing any approved dependency or exception.

title: User Account Control is configured as enabled
description: Checks that the machine EnableLUA value is explicitly 1. This configuration check does not determine whether a restart is pending or assess every UAC prompt policy.
remediation: Configure User Account Control according to approved policy and complete any required restart through the normal change process.

title: The SMBv1 server protocol is disabled
description: Checks EnableSMB1Protocol from Get-SmbServerConfiguration. This check covers server configuration, not the separate SMBv1 client feature.
remediation: Review legacy dependencies, then have the administrator disable the SMBv1 server protocol through approved configuration. Review SMBv1 client features separately.

title: Machine inactivity limit is explicitly non-zero
description: Requires a machine-level InactivityTimeoutSecs of at least 1. Missing policy or access denied is ERROR; a known zero value fails this control. User-specific screen-saver policies are outside scope.
remediation: Configure the machine interactive-logon inactivity limit to an approved non-zero value, at most 900 seconds for this baseline.

title: Machine inactivity limit is at most 900 seconds
description: Checks the upper bound of the explicit machine InactivityTimeoutSecs value. Read together with WIN-LOCK-001, the baseline requires 1 through 900 seconds.
remediation: Set the approved machine interactive-logon inactivity limit to 900 seconds or less, while retaining a non-zero limit.

title: UEFI Secure Boot is enabled
description: Uses Confirm-SecureBootUEFI. Legacy BIOS, unsupported hardware, unavailable cmdlets and denied access are ERROR, never assumed compliant.
remediation: Review hardware support, recovery access and boot compatibility with the administrator before enabling Secure Boot through the approved firmware process.

title: The Windows Event Log service is running
description: Checks the current EventLog service status. This does not validate log retention, audit-policy coverage or forwarding configuration.
remediation: Have the administrator review and restore the Windows Event Log service, then verify retention and forwarding policy separately.
